name: handloom-artisan-platform-root
description: Root runner for Handloom Artisan Support Platform

scripts.dev: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.start: npx concurrently --kill-others "npm start --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
